group.name: Rare deleterious variants
group.oneliner: Rare ClinVar pathogenic variants of the case

prompt.prompt: For the case in context, list rare variants (gnomAD < 1%) classified Pathogenic or Likely pathogenic in ClinVar, with zygosity, parental origin and VEP impact. Present them in a table.
Are there trio-confirmed de novo variants for this case? Prioritize those absent from gnomAD with HIGH or MODERATE impact, and report read depth and allelic ratio to assess call reliability.

group.name: Compound heterozygotes
group.oneliner: Two variants in trans in the same gene

prompt.prompt: For this case, search for genes carrying two rare variants (gnomAD < 1%) each inherited from a different parent (trans configuration). Keep only HIGH or MODERATE impacts and check consistency with an OMIM recessive inheritance mode.

Show the top 10 Exomiser ranking for this case (rank, gene, mode of inheritance, scores) and comment on each gene concordance with the observed HPO phenotypes. Flag intronic or biologically implausible candidates.

group.name: Phenotypes and panels
group.oneliner: Case HPO terms and associated genes

prompt.prompt: Detail this case positive HPO phenotypes (code and label), then list the genes associated with these phenotypes according to HPO panels. Indicate which genes recur across multiple phenotypes.

group.name: Full occurrence fact sheet
group.oneliner: Everything available on a case variant
